update.label: Update
update.draining: Daoris {{version}} installs when the work running now ends; nothing new starts meanwhile.
update.applying: Installing Daoris {{version}}. Daoris starts again in a moment.
update.refused: The staged Daoris {{version}} was not installed: {{why}}
update.rolledBack: Daoris {{version}} could not start, so Daoris went back to the build before it: {{why}}
update.refusedAtSwap: The staged Daoris {{version}} was refused before anything was replaced: {{why}}
update.why.schema: its build.json is a version this Daoris does not read.
update.why.path: its manifest names a path outside the build.
update.why.missing: a file its manifest names is missing.
update.why.size: a file is not the size its manifest says.
update.why.hash: a file is not the one its manifest names.
update.why.unlisted: it holds a file its manifest does not name.
update.why.required: it lacks a file every build carries.
update.why.host: this install carries its HTTP host and the build does not; stage it with --service.
update.why.launcher: the launcher would not start, so nothing was replaced.
update.why.busy: a file in app/ was held open, so nothing was replaced.
update.why.previous: what the last update left could not be cleared.
update.why.exited: the new build ended before it came up.
update.why.start: the new build would not start.
update.why.interrupted: the update was interrupted, and what it had moved was put back.
update.why.move: a file could not be moved for a reason other than being held open, so what had moved was put back; daoris-driver update says why.
update.why.error: the launcher met an error before it could put the build in place, so the build before it runs on; stage this one again to retry.
